newsitem.title: UK: Europe cotton spinners wary of firmer prices.
newsitem.headline: Europe cotton spinners wary of firmer prices.

text.p: Stronger nearby offers for most origins of raw cotton after Thursday's advance on New York futures has mostly deterred spinners for entering new purchasing commitments in European markets.
But inquiry to test prices was evident, reflecting gaps in mill inventories that remain uncovered ahead of the movement of the northern hemisphere 1997/98 winter crops late in the year.
Central Asian and West African were most in demand. Moderate business in Syrian was noted recently on some markets.
